verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a datacenter GPU accelerator. Getting AI-generated insights and suggestions from your own data inside the product is an application-level feature, so the question is a category error for compute hardware. The evidence shows no in-product insight capability that would make the axis apply: the 'AI-native' Spur scheduler handles job scheduling, and AMD SMI, Omnistat and the metrics exporter only monitor and profile GPUs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
